name: Futatsumori Keiko
source:
Keiko is a cheerful and caring girl. She suffers hospitalization just before entering high school, giving herself a late start into her new school life. She falls in love with [url=/c51538]Mikihiko[/url].

Gradually finding out that high school is different from middle school, she soon learns that her friends adapt to their new stage in life in ways she didn't expect.
